source_requirements.title: [v0.92.1][V3-16] Prove Parity, Run Canary Migration, And Cut Over Authority
source_requirements.required_disposition: Cutover may be approved only after parity, canary migration, rollback, observation-window, exact-review, and operator-approval evidence are current at #591 head.

satisfied_evidence.claim: 21 required v2 entrypoints have executable v3 command routes behind one csdlc surface
V3-H umbrella and six child issues are closed in live GitHub state
Real issue local-readiness canaries for #604, Sprint 8 #511, and Sprint 9 #515 completed under the three-minute target
Exact-head review remains a required pre-merge gate and is not claimed by this pre-review disposition
Pre-cutover rollback exercise was run: v3 terminal/cutover paths stayed non-authoritative, pre-cutover removal was denied, and typed v2 validation still passed afterward
Terminal v3 finish/cleanup canary consumed live GitHub PR #641 and issue #629 readbacks, then previewed cleanup against a registered exact-head worktree without removing it

blocking_evidence.claim: Current exact-head review and required hosted checks must pass before merge

source_requirements.title: [v0.92.1][V3-R01] Retire V2 After The Rollback Window
source_requirements.required_disposition: V2 retirement may occur only after cutover approval, successful stability/rollback window, deletion eligibility, fresh-install proof, historical-evidence readability, and no-v2-authority audit.

satisfied_evidence.claim: Current #505 artifacts preserve v2 as live authority and do not remove v2 binaries, skills, selector routes, or historical evidence
The v3 command denominator is implemented without claiming v2 retirement authority

blocking_evidence.claim: Rollback window has not started because PR #591 is not merged; terminal reconciliation records the transition after merge
Deletion inventory, fresh install without v2 artifacts, and final no-v2-authority audit are not part of this pre-approval #505 state

approval_blockers: Obtain a passing exact-head review and green required hosted checks.
Keep v2 as live authority until PR #591 is merged; merging PR #591 is the operator's cutover approval.
